summary.text: Ann Roe is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 44 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Ann Roe was born in Chicago, Illinois, and graduated from Evanston Township High School, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Lawrence University in 1988 and a graduate degree from Northeastern University in 1994, and her career experience includes working as a consultant.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Roe said she and her husband moved to Janesville more than 25 years earlier, that she had taught part-time at the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater for more than 25 years, and that she owns a small business, Custom College Solutions.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Roe described herself as a small business owner, community leader and retired college teacher, and named health care, public education and local government as the policy areas she is passionate about.
Roe was assigned to the Mental Health Committee and the State Affairs Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
